lines.text: 연못에 아침이 왔어요. 아기 개구리들이 아직 쿨쿨 자고 있네요.
lines.en: Morning came to the pond. The baby frogs are still fast asleep, zzz.
segs: Morning came to the pond. The baby frogs are still fast asleep, zzz.

lines.text: 아기 개구리들을 톡 눌러서 깨워 줄까요?
lines.en: Shall we tap the baby frogs to wake them up?
segs: Shall we tap the baby frogs to wake them up?

lines.text: 자고 있는 아기 개구리를 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap a sleeping baby frog!

lines.text: 엄마 개구리가 말했어요. "얘들아, 멀리 가면 안 된다~"
lines.en: Mama Frog said. "Children, don't go far away~"

lines.text: 아기 개구리들이 몰래 풀밭으로 나왔어요. 톡톡 눌러서 폴짝폴짝 가 볼까요?
lines.en: The baby frogs sneaked out to the meadow. Shall we tap, tap, and hop along?
segs: The baby frogs sneaked out to the meadow. Shall we tap, tap, and hop along?

lines.text: 화면을 톡톡 눌러서 폴짝폴짝!
lines.en: Tap the screen to hop, hop, hop!

lines.text: 어? 눈앞에 커다란 무언가가 있어요!
lines.en: Oh? Something huge is right in front of us!
segs: Oh? Something huge is right in front of us!

lines.text: 이건 뭘까요? 꼬리일까요, 나무일까요?
lines.en: What could this be? A tail or a tree?
segs: What could this be? A tail or a tree?

lines.text: 가운데 그림이랑 똑같이 생긴 쪽을 골라 봐요!
lines.en: Pick the one that looks just like the picture in the middle!

lines.text: 꼬리예요! 반짝이는 걸 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: It's a tail! Tap the sparkly one!

lines.text: 맞아요, 꼬리예요!
lines.en: That's right, it's a tail!

lines.text: 이번엔 뭘까요? 발굽일까요, 돌멩이일까요?
lines.en: What is it this time? A hoof or a pebble?

lines.text: 가운데 그림이랑 똑같이 생긴 쪽을 골라 봐요!
lines.en: Pick the one that looks just like the picture in the middle!

lines.text: 발굽이에요! 반짝이는 걸 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: It's a hoof! Tap the sparkly one!

lines.text: 맞아요, 발굽이에요!
lines.en: That's right, it's a hoof!

lines.text: 이건 뭘까요? 뿔일까요, 나뭇가지일까요?
lines.en: What could this be? A horn or a branch?

lines.text: 가운데 그림이랑 똑같이 생긴 쪽을 골라 봐요!
lines.en: Pick the one that looks just like the picture in the middle!

lines.text: 뿔이에요! 반짝이는 걸 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: It's a horn! Tap the sparkly one!

lines.text: 맞아요, 뿔이에요!
lines.en: That's right, it's a horn!

lines.text: 커다란 황소였어요! 아기 개구리들은 깜짝 놀라 도망쳤어요.
lines.en: It was a big, big ox! The baby frogs were so startled, they ran away.
segs: It was a big, big ox! The baby frogs were so startled, they ran away.

lines.text: "엄마! 산처럼 커다란 괴물을 봤어요!"
lines.en: "Mama! I saw a monster as big as a mountain!"
segs: Mama! I saw a monster as big as a mountain!

lines.text: 엄마 개구리가 말했어요. "흥, 얼마나 컸는데?"
lines.en: Mama Frog said. "Hmph, how big was it?"

lines.text: 누가 더 큰지 키를 재 볼까요?
lines.en: Shall we see who is bigger?

lines.text: 개구리랑 올챙이, 누가 더 커요?
lines.en: Who is bigger, the frog or the tadpole?

lines.text: 올챙이랑 개구리, 누가 더 커요?
lines.en: Who is bigger, the tadpole or the frog?

lines.text: 누가 더 커요? 큰 친구를 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Who is bigger? Tap the bigger friend!

lines.text: 둘이 나란히 섰어요. 머리가 더 높은 친구는 누구지?
lines.en: They're standing side by side. Whose head is higher?

lines.text: 개구리가 더 커요! 반짝이는 친구를 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: The frog is bigger! Tap the sparkly friend!

lines.text: 맞아요! 개구리가 더 커요!
lines.en: That's right! The frog is bigger!
segs: That's right! The frog is bigger!

lines.text: 오리랑 개구리, 누가 더 커요?
lines.en: Who is bigger, the duck or the frog?

lines.text: 개구리랑 오리, 누가 더 커요?
lines.en: Who is bigger, the frog or the duck?

lines.text: 누가 더 커요? 큰 친구를 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Who is bigger? Tap the bigger friend!

lines.text: 둘이 나란히 섰어요. 머리가 더 높은 친구는 누구지?
lines.en: They're standing side by side. Whose head is higher?

lines.text: 오리가 더 커요! 반짝이는 친구를 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: The duck is bigger! Tap the sparkly friend!

lines.text: 맞아요! 오리가 더 커요!
lines.en: That's right! The duck is bigger!
segs: That's right! The duck is bigger!

lines.text: 양이랑 오리, 누가 더 커요?
lines.en: Who is bigger, the sheep or the duck?

lines.text: 오리랑 양, 누가 더 커요?
lines.en: Who is bigger, the duck or the sheep?

lines.text: 누가 더 커요? 큰 친구를 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Who is bigger? Tap the bigger friend!

lines.text: 둘이 나란히 섰어요. 머리가 더 높은 친구는 누구지?
lines.en: They're standing side by side. Whose head is higher?

lines.text: 양이 더 커요! 반짝이는 친구를 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: The sheep is bigger! Tap the sparkly friend!

lines.text: 맞아요! 양이 더 커요!
lines.en: That's right! The sheep is bigger!
segs: That's right! The sheep is bigger!

lines.text: 황소랑 양, 누가 더 커요?
lines.en: Who is bigger, the ox or the sheep?

lines.text: 양이랑 황소, 누가 더 커요?
lines.en: Who is bigger, the sheep or the ox?

lines.text: 누가 더 커요? 큰 친구를 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Who is bigger? Tap the bigger friend!

lines.text: 둘이 나란히 섰어요. 머리가 더 높은 친구는 누구지?
lines.en: They're standing side by side. Whose head is higher?

lines.text: 황소가 더 커요! 반짝이는 친구를 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: The ox is bigger! Tap the sparkly friend!

lines.text: 맞아요! 황소가 더 커요!
lines.en: That's right! The ox is bigger!
segs: That's right! The ox is bigger!

lines.text: "흥, 나도 황소만큼 클 수 있어!" 엄마 개구리가 숨을 크게 들이마셨어요.
lines.en: "I can be as big as an ox!" Mama Frog took a deep breath.
segs: I can be as big as an ox!
Mama Frog took a deep breath.

lines.text: 엄마 개구리를 톡톡 눌러서 부풀려 볼까요?
lines.en: Shall we tap, tap, and puff up Mama Frog?
segs: Shall we tap, tap, and puff up Mama Frog?

lines.text: 엄마 개구리를 톡톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap, tap, tap Mama Frog!

lines.text: "아직 황소가 더 커요!"
lines.en: "The ox is still bigger!"

lines.text: "와, 양만큼 커졌다! 그래도 황소가 더 커요!"
lines.en: "Wow, as big as a sheep! But the ox is still bigger!"
segs: Wow, as big as a sheep! But the ox is still bigger!

lines.text: 엄마 개구리가 부들부들 떨려요. 어어… 한 번 더 누르면 어떻게 될까?
lines.en: Mama Frog is trembling and wobbling. Uh-oh... what happens if we tap one more time?
segs: Mama Frog is trembling and wobbling. Uh-oh... what happens if we tap one more time?

lines.text: 푸슈슈슉~ 엄마 개구리가 풍선처럼 날아다녀요! 톡 눌러서 잡아 줘요!
lines.en: Fshhhhh~ Mama Frog is flying around like a balloon! Tap to catch her!
segs: Fshhhhh~ Mama Frog is flying around like a balloon! Tap to catch her!

lines.text: 날아다니는 엄마 개구리를 톡!
lines.en: Tap Mama Frog as she flies!

lines.text: 엄마 개구리는 원래 크기로 돌아왔어요. 어지러워도 깔깔깔 웃었답니다.
lines.en: Mama Frog was back to her normal size. Dizzy as she was, she laughed ha ha ha.
segs: Mama Frog was back to her normal size. Dizzy as she was, she laughed ha ha ha.

lines.text: 황소가 몸을 낮추고 다정하게 말했어요. "크지 않아도 괜찮아. 너는 폴짝 뛰기 선수잖아!"
lines.en: The ox bent down low and said kindly. "It's okay not to be big. You're a hopping champion!"
segs: The ox bent down low and said kindly.
It's okay not to be big. You're a hopping champion!

lines.text: 엄마 개구리를 톡 눌러서 폴짝!
lines.en: Tap Mama Frog to hop!

lines.text: 황소도 따라 뛰어 볼까요? 하나, 둘…
lines.en: Shall the ox try hopping too? One, two...

lines.text: 쿵! 황소는 폴짝 뛰지 못했어요. 누가 더 멀리 뛸까요? 개구리!
lines.en: Thud! The ox couldn't hop. Who can jump farther? The frog!
segs: Thud! The ox couldn't hop. Who can jump farther? The frog!

lines.text: 밤이 되었어요. 나비넥타이를 맨 삼촌 개구리가 놀러 왔어요. 개구리 가족이 노래를 불러요. 먼저 들어 봐요!
lines.en: Night came. Uncle Frog, wearing a bow tie, came to visit. The frog family sings a song. Listen first!
segs: Night came. Uncle Frog, wearing a bow tie, came to visit. The frog family sings a song. Listen first!

lines.text: 이번에는 개구리를 톡톡 눌러서 같이 불러요!
lines.en: This time, tap the frogs and sing along!
segs: This time, tap the frogs and sing along!

lines.text: 개굴개굴~ 노래가 잦아들고, 개구리 가족은 쿨쿨 잠이 들었답니다.
lines.en: Ribbit, ribbit~ The song faded away, and the frog family fell fast asleep.
segs: Ribbit, ribbit~ The song faded away, and the frog family fell fast asleep.

ui.개구리는 개구리대로 멋져요!: Frogs are wonderful just as they are!
